annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost

maint.note: 2012+ FB engines need 0W-20 full synthetic; WRX/STI turbo engines need closer oil checks.
WRX/STI performance brakes cost noticeably more.
Some older base models use rear drum brakes instead.
Models with auto start-stop need an AGM battery.

maint.every: Follow the owner’s manual; conventional plugs last about 30,000–40,000 miles and long-life plugs much longer
maint.note: Turbo WRX/STI engines cost more (YourMechanic estimates reach about $666 on a 2007 2.5L Turbo). YourMechanic average: about $210; KBB dealer range for a 2009: $291–343.

maint.every: About every 30,000 miles or 5 years per KBB; newer long-life Subaru coolant can go longer, so check the owner’s manual
maint.note: KBB fair price for a 2013 Impreza: $255–332 total.
